title: Fix iOS APNs token registration - Add /api prefix to backend URL path
description: iOS app fails to register APNs token with backend. Backend returns 500 Internal Server Error: 'No static resource sessions/devices/apns-token'. Root cause: iOS constructs URL as http://192.168.0.173:8080/sessions/devices/apns-token (missing /api prefix). Backend controller is correctly mapped to /api/sessions/devices/apns-token but Spring treats the request as static resource lookup because it doesn't match any @RequestMapping. Fix needed in iOS ApiClient.swift line 203: change path from '/sessions/devices/apns-token' to '/api/sessions/devices/apns-token'. This ensures full URL becomes http://192.168.0.173:8080/api/sessions/devices/apns-token which matches backend controller mapping.

title: Fix Swift concurrency errors - Wrap async TimerSyncManager calls in Task blocks
description: Swift compilation errors in macOSContentView.swift and iOSContentView.swift. TimerSyncManager.shared.syncTimerAction() is async but called from synchronous SwiftUI Button action closures. Fix: Wrap all 6 async calls in Task { await ... } blocks to handle concurrency properly. Locations: macOSContentView.swift playPauseButton (line 227), resetButton (line 245), startWithPermission (line 264). iOSContentView.swift PrimaryButton action (line 114), resetButton (line 132), startWithPermission (line 167).

title: Fix timer sync - Update macOS and iOS UI button handlers to use TimerSyncManager
description: Timer buttons in macOS and iOS UI call PomodoroTimer methods directly (timer.start(), timer.pause(), timer.reset()), bypassing TimerSyncManager. This causes no timer events to be sent to backend, preventing cross-device sync. Backend logs show only auth requests with NO timer action events. macOS logs show NO TimerSyncManager calls. Fix required: 1) Update macOS UI (macOSContentView.swift lines 226, 241, 254-261) to call TimerSyncManager.shared.syncTimerAction() instead of direct timer methods. 2) Update iOS UI (iOSContentView.swift lines 112-118, 132, 161) similarly. 3) Verify TimerSyncManager implementation (lines 70-110) is correct. 4) Fix backend user_devices.updated_at null constraint if needed. 5) Grant macOS notification permissions. 6) Test sync flow between devices.

title: Update AGENTS.md - Add comprehensive Device Log Access Guide section for iOS physical devices
description: AGENTS.md currently contains incorrect iOS log file path: /Users/kayisrahman/Documents/TimeBeamLogs/timebeam_ios.log. This path does not exist on physical iOS devices due to app sandboxing. The file is actually located inside the app's sealed container. This needs to be fixed with: 1) Create dedicated 'Device Log Access Guide' section documenting three access methods: Xcode Download Container (recommended), Console.app (real-time), and Programmatic path discovery. 2) Update Error Fixing Workflow section to reference new guide instead of hardcoded path. 3) Update Additional Resources section with link to new guide.
